units.source_text: 千重子走到御旅所 [3] 前，买了一根蜡烛，点着了供在神前。

en.t: Chieko walked to the front of the otabisho [3], bought a candle, lit it, and offered it before the deity.

units.source_text: 在节日期间，也把八坂神社的神请到御旅所来。

en.t: During the festival, the deity of Yasaka Shrine is also brought to the otabisho.

units.source_text: 御旅所坐落在从新京极走出四条大街的南边。

en.t: The otabisho is located on the south side where one comes out from Shinkyogoku onto Shijo Street.
